purpose: Baseline local model registry for secure distributed AI worker nodes.

policy.transport: outbound-only worker polling plus private RoRe health/messages
policy.model_selection: SUN/PB may request a model; the worker must report the actual model used
policy.storage: SUN/PB owns Backblaze storage keys and public file URLs
policy.bakes: MAZA bakes are counted by SUN/PB only after accepting a completed artifact

baseline.role: balanced local retrieval for job payloads, context packs, and repair prompts
default local writer, answerer, and repair model
media inspection and rendered-page visual QA

optional.role: explicit OCR extraction for jobs that enable OCR preflight
